tagline: Three-color cameras胶片相机，1939 年发布
description: Three-color cameras于1939年推出的胶片相机。

specs.英文简介: The Spektaretta is a camera that makes colour images by a colour-separation method: the image from the lens is split into three by a system of prisms, to make three simultaneous exposures (24×24 mm) through red, green and blue filters, onto monochrome 35 mm film.[https://web.archive.org/web/20210411045450/http://www.ntm.cz/en/glossary/spektaretta Notes on the Spektaretta] (archived at Internet Arc
